title: Universaarl Number Series Lines Personalize field/action map
goal: Use the proven Personalize mode on No. Series Lines to map available fields/actions without changing or saving personalization, then decide whether Personalize can expose a safer field route.
knownLearningFromTarget016F: Settings/Gear opens an Einstellungen pane where Personalisieren is a visible text link, not necessarily a role=menuitem.
Clicking Personalisieren enters a page-level personalization mode for Nr.-Serienzeilen, visible as Wird personalisiert: Nr.-Serienzeilen with Fertig.
Fertig exits the personalization mode after no field/action changes were made.
The tested Weitere Optionen route did not produce a useful action menu and must not be treated as a setup route.
successCriteria: Personalize mode is entered on Nr.-Serienzeilen and field/action affordances are screenshot-documented.
No field/action is added, removed or moved unless a later explicit gate allows it.
No setup assignment, master data, preview posting or posting occurs.
nextSafeAction: Map Personalize field/action affordances without changing personalization.
result: Personalize mode mapped Startnr./Endnr./checkbox field context without saving changes; no safe Add field/value-entry route was visible.
